item.title: Kansas Wildlife and Parks asks lawmakers to raise migratory bird hunting fees
item.description: TOPEKA — Kansas migratory bird hunters will pay more to hunt under a proposed bill, but hunting organizations supported the need to increase fees.

item.title: Emporia State weighs fate of Social Change program as Kansas lawmakers target DEI
item.description: EMPORIA — Emporia State University freshman Hayden Gust told faculty members Thursday he wouldn’t be standing in front of them if he hadn’t met Mallory Bishop.

item.title: Tackling the junk drawer
item.description: Dear Readers, Isn’t it a treat to have a respite from bitterly cold snowy conditions? We all know, no matter what Punxsutawney Phil says, that winter’s not over but it sure is nice not to be housebound. For the first one or two days of a winter storm, I’m thrilled.

item.title: Strong Lamb Demand Spurs New Focus on Producer Growth
item.description: The American Lamb Board is reporting strong market growth for the sheep industry and is shifting additional resources toward education and research to help expand domestic lamb production. David Fischer, vice chairman of the American Lamb Board, said recently released second-quarter reports show significant gains in both sales dollars and volume.

item.title: LADY BULLPUPS ROLL IN WICHITA, SLIP LATE TO ANDALE
item.description: MCPHERSON – The McPherson girls basketball team grinded it out on the road through the first week of February by getting a dominating road victory at Wichita Collegiate (66-28) on Tuesday before falling late in a game on Thursday at Andale (41-47). With the split, the Lady Bullpups now sit at 8-9 for the season after going 2-5 in December and 5-3 in January.

item.title: BULLPUPS SPLIT ROAD TESTS
item.description: MCPHERSON – The McPherson Bullpups emerged from a challenging week with a split of games, losing to Wichita Collegiate (53-72) on Tuesday before bouncing back with an impressive win over ranked Andale (58-49) Andale on Thursday. On Tuesday, after McPherson played to within three at the end of the first quarter, Wichita Collegiate outscored the Bullpups 15-8 in the second quarter to take a 10-point, 22-32 advantage into the halftime break.

item.title: FROM THE BLEACHERS-747 When College Football Became Professional
item.description: The national title game between Miami and Indiana will be remembered not just for the final score, but for what it represents.

item.title: How Bad Bunny pulled off a historic Super Bowl halftime show
item.description: Bad Bunny scored a touchdown before either team did during Super Bowl LX on Sunday, marching down the field during his halftime show before spiking a football at the end zone.

item.title: Hearing for data centers, other new technology
item.description: McPherson County will hold a public hearing about how the county should regulate data centers, battery energy storage systems, hydrogen energy, and nuclear power, including whether each should even be allowed. The hearing, scheduled to last up to three hours, will begin at 1 p.m.

item.title: KDOT accepting applications for grants available through TA program
item.description: The Kansas Department of Transportation (KDOT) is accepting applications for $32 million in available grant funding for construction projects through the Transportation Alternatives (TA) Program. These funds help communities design and build non-motorized forms of transportation projects that can have significant local and regional impacts.
